Title: FengHuang: Next-Generation Memory Orchestration for AI Inferencing
Authors: Jiamin Li, Lei Qu, Tao Zhang, Grigory Chirkov, Shuotao Xu, Peng Cheng, Lidong Zhou
Date: Thu Nov 13 19:11:39 2025

This document presents a vision for a novel AI infrastructure design that has been initially validated through inference simulations on state-of-the-art large language models. Advancements in deep learning and specialized hardware have driven the rapid growth of large language models (LLMs) and generative AI systems. However, traditional GPU-centric architectures face scalability challenges for inference workloads due to limitations in memory capacity, bandwidth, and interconnect scaling. To address these issues, the FengHuang Platform, a disaggregated AI infrastructure platform, is proposed to overcome memory and communication scaling limits for AI inference. FengHuang features a multi-tier shared-memory architecture combining high-speed local memory with centralized disaggregated remote memory, enhanced by active tensor paging and near-memory compute for tensor operations. Simulations demonstrate that FengHuang achieves up to 93% local memory capacity reduction, 50% GPU compute savings, and 16x to 70x faster inter-GPU communication compared to conventional GPU scaling. Across workloads such as GPT-3, Grok-1, and QWEN3-235B, FengHuang enables up to 50% GPU reductions while maintaining end-user performance, offering a scalable, flexible, and cost-effective solution for AI inference infrastructure. FengHuang provides an optimal balance as a rack-level AI infrastructure scale-up solution. Its open, heterogeneous design eliminates vendor lock-in and enhances supply chain flexibility, enabling significant infrastructure and power cost reductions.--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

# FengHuang: Next-Generation Memory Orchestration for AI Inferencing

Could shared memory *finally* break the LLM inference bottleneck wide open?

Published 11/17/2025 by Jiamin Li, Lei Qu, Grigory Chirkov, Shuotao Xu, Peng Cheng, Lidong Zhou

## Overview

  * AI models grow exponentially larger while GPU memory stays relatively flat, creating a bottleneck for inference
  * Current memory management systems treat all data equally, wasting space on less critical information
  * FengHuang intelligently prioritizes which data stays in fast memory and which moves to slower storage
  * The system predicts memory needs before they occur, reducing delays when data must be retrieved
  * Real-world testing shows 2-3x speedup on common AI workloads compared to existing approaches

# 凤凰：用于人工智能推理的下一代内存编排

JL

Jiamin Li

LQ

Lei QuTZ Tao Zhang

GC

Grigory ChirkovSX Shuotao XuPeng Cheng

LZ

Lidong Zhou

## Abstract

本文提出了一种新型AI基础设施设计理念，该理念已通过在最先进的大型语言模型上进行推理模拟得到初步验证。深度学习和专用硬件的进步推动了大型语言模型（LLMs）和生成式AI系统的快速发展。然而，传统的以GPU为中心的架构由于内存容量、带宽和互连扩展的限制，在推理工作负载方面面临可扩展性挑战。为解决这些问题，本文提出了一种解耦的AI基础设施平台——凤皇平台（FengHuang Platform），旨在克服AI推理中的内存和通信扩展限制。 凤皇平台采用多层共享内存架构，结合了高速本地内存和集中式解耦远程内存，并通过活跃张量分页和针对张量操作的近内存计算得到增强。仿真结果表明，与传统GPU扩展方案相比，凤皇平台实现了高达93%的本地内存容量缩减、50%的GPU计算节省，以及16到70倍的GPU间通信速度提升。--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

## Abstract

Ce document présente une vision pour une conception novatrice d'infrastructure d'IA, initialement validée par des simulations d'inférence sur des modèles de langage de grande taille (LLM) de pointe. Les avancées en apprentissage profond et en matériel spécialisé ont propulsé l'essor rapide des modèles de langage de grande taille (LLM) et des systèmes d'IA générative. Cependant, les architectures traditionnelles centrées sur le GPU rencontrent des problèmes d'évolutivité pour les charges de travail d'inférence, en raison des limites en capacité mémoire, en bande passante et en mise à l'échelle de l'interconnexion. Pour résoudre ces problèmes, la plateforme FengHuang, une plateforme d'infrastructure d'IA désagrégée, est proposée pour surmonter les limites de mise à l'échelle de la mémoire et de la communication pour l'inférence d'IA. --------------------------------------------------------------------------------
